reason: E2 states the parent Hf-Nb-Ta-Ti-Zr alloys are close to BCS phonon-mediated superconductors, supporting the first premise. However, neither E1 nor E2 provides evidence that Tc is governed by DOS-modulated electron-phonon coupling, that V substitution will shift DOS, or that a systematic DOS-Tc correlation exists; these key mechanistic premises are unsupported by the cited passages.
premises: Superconductivity in Nb-Ti-Zr-Hf-Ta is BCS-type phonon-mediated
Tc is governed by electron-phonon coupling strength
Electron-phonon coupling is modulated by DOS at the Fermi level
Substituting Ti with V changes valence electron count and thus DOS
Higher DOS at EF enhances Tc, lower DOS reduces Tc
